title: Graded Traction and Acceleration
description: Compare how P1, P2 and P3 request traction and how train speed responds.

steps.instruction: Select P1 and observe the speedometer for the low traction request.
Select P2 and compare the commanded power level with P1.
Select P3 and observe that train speed changes progressively, not immediately.
Observe the speedometer reaching at least 1 km/h; compare actual speed with the controller position.
Return to N. Explain why the moving train does not instantly stop.

learningObjective: Distinguish a power detent’s requested effort from the speed actually achieved.
expectedObservations: Traction detents request increasing power in this teaching configuration.
Speed changes over time, rather than jumping to a preset value.
N removes the active traction request but does not instantly stop movement.
debriefQuestions: Does P3 correspond to one fixed km/h value?
Which instrument confirms the train is accelerating?
